simulationComponentAdditions.description: Overlay for the simulation components that Neko-TOP registers, applied to every entry of `case.simulation_components`.
simulationComponentAdditions.$comment: sources/simulation_components/neko_top_simcomps.f90:54 registers `steady`. Neko's registered-type fallback admits it; the overlay types its keys. An entry with `is_user: true` is skipped by Neko's factory before any key is read (neko src/simulation_components/simulation_component_fctry.f90:108-109), whatever its type, so the overlay leaves it to Neko's open `is_user` branch; the other entries already pass Neko's simcompBase through the fallback branch.
